target.title: perf(home): batch publisher hydration (#3067 / #2925)
target.body:
## Summary

- What changed: This PR proposes one bounded public publisher-summary query for the ten pinned home publishers and requests it once as the section approaches the viewport.
- Why: The home page currently hydrates ten full publisher profiles serially. The proposed query reads only normalized, unique handles, preserves publisher and linked-user visibility, and leaves incomplete or unavailable publishers on the static fallback cards.

## Linked Issue

- Closes #3067
- Related #2925

## Screenshots

- [x] Real fallback and hydrated ClawHub captures are embedded in a PR comment.

## Behavioural Proof

On the real home page with a local Convex fixture, the publisher section rendered ten static fallback cards with zero summary requests above the fold. Scrolling 700 px issued exactly one `publishers:getHomePublisherSummaries` request containing the ten pinned handles; repeated scrolling issued no additional requests. The one-result fixture response was 339 bytes of JSON and 617 encoded transfer bytes, and the hydrated card changed from `Explore creator` to `Explore 1 item`.

- [x] Behavioural proof included

## Security / Trust Impact

- [x] No security/trust impact. The proposed summary query reuses publisher and linked-user visibility rules and omits incomplete denormalized counters.

## Data / Deploy Impact

- [x] No data/deploy impact. No schema, migration, backfill, or production deployment is required.

## Verification

- [x] `bun run ci:static`
- [x] Focused tests: `bun run test -- convex/publishers.test.ts src/__tests__/home-popular-publishers-section.test.tsx`
- [x] `bun run ci:unit`
- [x] `bun run ci:types-build`
- [x] `bunx convex codegen`
- [x] `git diff --check`
